title: Source-fibre differential comparison formula
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k smooth, c:B -> Spec k, U an open of Y, z a point of U, K=kappa_U(z), T a scheme, and h:T -> Spec K and g:T -> B times_k Y satisfy the source-point factorization. Let A=Gamma(T,O_T) and p:B times_k Y -> B. There is an A-linear map D:A tensor_K bertiniCotangentFibre(f,U,z) -> Gamma(T,g^*Omega_p). For every source open W containing U.ι(z), every a in Gamma(Y,W), every b in A, and every proof hV that g maps T into the inverse image of W, D sends b tensor the differential component of bertiniLocalFirstJet(f,U,z,W,a) to b times the restriction to T of g^*(d(pr_Y^*a)). No injectivity is asserted. [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-module-pullback, def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf, lem-zl-bertini-local-first-jets].

proof.text: Write p = pr_Y and q = pr_B. The sheaf derivation a ↦ d_q(p^sharp(a)) is relative to f: it kills base functions by the pullback square. The universal property of Omega_f therefore constructs a morphism tau:Omega_f -> p_*Omega_q with its defining formula on local differentials.

Compose tau with p_* of the section-normalized unit Omega_q -> g_*g^*Omega_q, and identify the composite pushforward with (g composed with p)_*. This gives phi:Omega_f -> (g composed with p)_*N, where N=g^*Omega_q. On da its value is the actual tensorPullbackSection of d_q(p^sharp(a)).

For every open V of U containing z, hg ensures that the whole of T maps into the image of V in Y. Apply phi to a section of Omega_f over this image and restrict its image to all of T. These additive maps commute with restriction. The colimit definition of the module stalk gives an additive map L from the stalk at z of the open restriction of Omega_f to Gamma(T,N). For a local scalar a, the scalar on its image is (g composed with p)^sharp(a); the factorization hg and h_alpha identify this with alpha(residue(germ(a))). Thus L is linear over O_U,z acting through this ring map.

Compose L with the stalk map of the canonical morphism Omega_(U/k) -> Omega_(Y/k)|_U. Extend scalars first from R=O_U,z to K=kappa_U(z) and then from K to A=Gamma(T,O_T), using alpha. The tensor-Hom adjunction produces the required A-linear map D from A tensor_K the actual cotangent fibre.

Evaluate D on b tensor (1 tensor germ(d(U.ι^sharp(a)))). The open-restriction differential morphism sends this germ to the restriction of d(a); naturality of phi then removes the intermediate restriction to U intersect W. The normalized unit formula for phi gives exactly b times the restriction to T of tensorPullbackSection g applied to d_q(p^sharp(a)). Proof irrelevance identifies every allowed choice of hV. The construction also works for empty T and a zero cotangent fibre; it uses no finite basis or smoothness.
